__global__ void scale_kernel(const float* a, float* out, const float factor, int size) {

# ---------- Elementwise division by scalar ----------
elementwise_div_cuda_src = """
torch::Tensor elementwise_div_cuda(torch::Tensor a, float scalar) {
    auto size = a.numel();
    auto out = torch::zeros_like(a);

    const int block_size = 256;
    const int num_blocks = (size + block_size - 1) / block_size;

    scale_kernel<<<num_blocks, block_size>>>(a.data_ptr<float>(), out.data_ptr<float()>, scalar, size);

}

elementwise_div_cpp_src = (
